meta.author: Śrīla Narottam Dās Ṭhākur
meta.first_line: hari haraye namaḥ kṛṣṇa yādavāya namaḥ

text: hari haraye namaḥ kṛṣṇa yādavāya namaḥ
translation: O Lord Hari, O Lord Kṛṣṇa, I offer my obeisances to You, who are known as Yādava, Hari, Mādhava, and Keśava.
O Gopāla, Govinda, Rāma, Śrī Madhusūdan, Giridhārī, Gopīnāth, Madana-mohan!
All glories to Śrī Chaitanya and Nityānanda. All glories to the moonlike Śrī Advaita Āchārya. All glories to Śrī Gadādhar Paṇḍit and all the devotees of Śrī Chaitanya headed by Śrīvās Ṭhākur.
All glories to Śrī Rūpa Goswāmī, Sanātan Goswāmī, Raghunāth Bhaṭṭa Goswāmī, Śrī Jīva Goswāmī, Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Goswāmī, and Raghunāth Dās Goswāmī.

text: ei chhaya gosāñi kari charaṇa vandana
translation: I offer my obeisances to the Six Goswāmīs. By offering them my obeisances all obstacles to devotion are destroyed and all spiritual desires are fulfilled.

text: ei chhaya gosāñi yā̐ra mu̐i tā̐ra dāsa
translation: I am a servant of that person who is a servant of these six Goswāmīs. The dust of their holy feet is my five kinds of foodstuffs.

text: tā̐dera charaṇa sevi bhakta sane vāsa
translation: This is my desire, that birth after birth I may live with those devotees who serve the lotus feet of these six Goswāmīs.

text: ei chhaya gosāñi yabe vraje kailā vāsa
translation: When these six Goswāmīs lived in Vraja, they revealed and explained the eternal Pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.
Absorbing your mind in meditation upon the divine feet of the Spiritual Master and the holy Vaiṣṇavas, chant the Names of Lord Hari in ecstasy, and worship the transcendental realm of Vṛndāvan.
Desiring the lotus feet of Śrī Guru and the Vaiṣṇavas, Narottam Dās sings the saṅkīrtan of the Holy Name.
